Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.compat.gecko

Class GooglyGeoLayer<T extends net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity & software.bernie.geckolib.animatable.GeoAnimatable>

java.lang.Object
software.bernie.geckolib.renderer.layer.GeoRenderLayer<T>
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.compat.gecko.GooglyGeoLayer<T>
public class GooglyGeoLayer<T extends net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity & software.bernie.geckolib.animatable.GeoAnimatable> extends software.bernie.geckolib.renderer.layer.GeoRenderLayer<T>
GeckoLib render layer that draws googly eyes on named bones (the GeckoLib counterpart of LayerGooglyEyes + PickerLayer). Handles both normal rendering (from synced config, with iris physics) and the picker preview when this entity is the picker's target.

The layer works through GeckoLib's per-bone hook, not the whole-model render(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, T, software.bernie.geckolib.cache.object.BakedGeoModel, net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType, net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer, float, int, int, int) callback: GeckoLib applies the entity's body rotations and model transforms inside its own push/pop and has already popped them by the time render runs, so only renderForBone(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, T, software.bernie.geckolib.cache.object.GeoBone, net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType, net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer, float, int, int, int) sees a pose actually positioned at the animated bone. Per-entity gating and bone lookup happen once in preRender(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, T, software.bernie.geckolib.cache.object.BakedGeoModel, net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType, net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer, float, int, int, int); renderForBone(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, T, software.bernie.geckolib.cache.object.GeoBone, net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType, net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer, float, int, int, int) draws on the matching bones; render(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, T, software.bernie.geckolib.cache.object.BakedGeoModel, net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType, net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer, float, int, int, int) (which GeckoLib calls last) just clears the per-render state.

Only loaded when GeckoLib is present (referenced via GeckoCompatImpl).
